TagLibSharp 2.3.0 — LGPL-2.1-only
Copyright the TagLib# contributors; see AUTHORS in the source archive.

ShuffleDrop loads the unmodified TagLibSharp.dll dynamically for metadata reading.
You may modify/rebuild the library and replace it with a compatible DLL.
Reverse engineering to debug modifications to the library is permitted.
The application license does not restrict these rights.

TagLibSharp-LICENSE.txt contains the LGPL 2.1 license.
taglib-sharp-2.3.0-source.zip contains corresponding library sources and build files
from tag TaglibSharp-2.3.0.0. Large test media are excluded; library sources are unchanged.
Build src/TaglibSharp/TaglibSharp.csproj for net462 with an appropriate .NET SDK.
https://github.com/mono/taglib-sharp/tree/TaglibSharp-2.3.0.0
https://www.nuget.org/packages/TagLibSharp/2.3.0
